name: Write the ship log
description: Read today's work across the configured repositories and write it as shipped, in progress and blocked. Follow the stored procedures 'How to read a day's work' and 'How to write the ship log'. Read the installation settings included with this run and honour 'repositories', 'post_to', 'post_at' and 'include_reviews'. Use the working_day_window function for the exact window, so a run started by hand covers today up to now rather than a fixed span.
response_policy: Post to the configured channel when there is one, and deliver as a chat message when there is not.
